name: ryu.family
description: A shared family hub for Ryu: important dates with reminders, shared lists and chores, wishlists, and gift ideas that stay hidden from the person they are for. The node your family uses keeps the records; nothing is bought on your behalf.

family.description: Family hub tools for upcoming dates, people, shared lists and chores, family-visible preferences and wishlists, and gift context. Gift ideas and wishlist claims are never exposed through these tools.
